blocker_description: The frozen champion model requires 6 non-linear dynamical features (spread1, spread2, PPE, RPDE, DFA, D2) developed by Max Little et al. (2007). These features cannot be reliably computed from live browser microphone recordings using standard acoustic software (Praat/Parselmouth). Because SHAP analysis revealed that spread1, PPE, and spread2 represent >60% of model predictive attribution, substituting dummy values (zeros or means) would result in clinically invalid predictions.

feature_details.name: MDVP:Fo(Hz)
feature_details.math_desc: Average fundamental vocal frequency (pitch)

feature_details.name: MDVP:Fhi(Hz)
feature_details.math_desc: Maximum fundamental vocal frequency

feature_details.name: MDVP:Flo(Hz)
feature_details.math_desc: Minimum fundamental vocal frequency

feature_details.name: MDVP:Jitter(%)
feature_details.math_desc: Cycle-to-cycle percentage variation in fundamental period

feature_details.name: MDVP:Jitter(Abs)
feature_details.math_desc: Absolute cycle-to-cycle variation in fundamental period (seconds)

feature_details.name: MDVP:RAP
feature_details.math_desc: Relative Average Perturbation (3-cycle average)

feature_details.name: MDVP:PPQ
feature_details.math_desc: Five-point Period Perturbation Quotient

feature_details.name: Jitter:DDP
feature_details.math_desc: Average absolute difference of differences between consecutive periods (3 * RAP)

feature_details.name: MDVP:Shimmer
feature_details.math_desc: Cycle-to-cycle percentage variation in amplitude peak

feature_details.name: MDVP:Shimmer(dB)
feature_details.math_desc: Logarithmic cycle-to-cycle amplitude perturbation in decibels

feature_details.name: Shimmer:APQ3
feature_details.math_desc: Three-point Amplitude Perturbation Quotient

feature_details.name: Shimmer:APQ5
feature_details.math_desc: Five-point Amplitude Perturbation Quotient

feature_details.name: MDVP:APQ
feature_details.math_desc: 11-point Amplitude Perturbation Quotient

feature_details.name: Shimmer:DDA
feature_details.math_desc: Average absolute differences between consecutive amplitude differences (3 * APQ3)

feature_details.name: NHR
feature_details.math_desc: Noise-to-Harmonics Ratio (incoherent spectral energy fraction)

feature_details.name: HNR
feature_details.math_desc: Harmonics-to-Noise Ratio (dB), ratio of periodic to noise component

feature_details.name: RPDE
feature_details.math_desc: Recurrence Period Density Entropy: measures deviation from periodicity via phase space embedding

feature_details.name: DFA
feature_details.math_desc: Detrended Fluctuation Analysis: fractal scaling exponent of turbulent acoustic time series

feature_details.name: spread1
feature_details.math_desc: Non-linear fundamental frequency variation distribution spread (semitone-entropy tail)

feature_details.name: spread2
feature_details.math_desc: Secondary non-linear spectral frequency variation distribution spread

feature_details.name: D2
feature_details.math_desc: Correlation Dimension: Grassberger-Procaccia phase space attractor fractal dimension

feature_details.name: PPE
feature_details.math_desc: Pitch Period Entropy: logarithmic semitone entropy sensitive to dysphonia, insensitive to healthy pitch drift

recommended_resolutions.description: Train an isolated 16-feature model on the UCI dataset using only the Praat-extractable perturbation features under the same rigorous LOGO/SGKF cross-validation. This enables true end-to-end microphone recording inference without unverified algorithmic approximations.

recommended_resolutions.strategy: Algorithmic port of Max Little C/MATLAB routines
recommended_resolutions.description: Port the exact phase space reconstruction, Grassberger-Procaccia dimension (D2), recurrence entropy (RPDE), detrended fluctuation (DFA), and semitone entropy (PPE, spread1/2) into Python. Requires calibration against original audio recordings to prevent distribution shift.
